reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → ADE dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance over time
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.recommended_knobs.top_k=4 AND shrinkage=0.35 → matches regularization parameters for high noise and few windows
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection captures differing model strengths across forecast horizons
